name: PlayStation 5 Console
shortDescription: Next-gen console with ultra-fast SSD and 4K gaming.
longDescription: PlayStation 5 delivers fast loading, immersive haptics, and 4K support. Includes one DualSense controller and a 1TB SSD.

name: Xbox Series X Console
shortDescription: Powerful console built for 4K gaming and quick resume.
longDescription: Xbox Series X features fast load times, stable 4K performance, and quick resume between games. Includes one controller and a 1TB SSD.

name: Nintendo Switch OLED
shortDescription: Hybrid console with vibrant OLED screen and docked play.
longDescription: Nintendo Switch OLED offers a larger, brighter screen for handheld play and a dock for TV gaming. Includes Joy-Con controllers and dock.

name: Elden Ring
shortDescription: Open-world action RPG with deep combat and exploration.
longDescription: Elden Ring blends open-world discovery with challenging combat and rich lore. Includes base game, standard edition.

name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
shortDescription: Mid-high GPU for 1440p gaming with ray tracing.
longDescription: The RTX 4070 delivers smooth 1440p performance with ray tracing and DLSS support. Requires a compatible PCIe system.

name: Starter Gaming PC
shortDescription: Entry-level prebuilt gaming PC ready for esports titles.
longDescription: Starter Gaming PC includes a 6-core CPU, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, and a dedicated GPU. Ideal for 1080p gaming.

name: DualSense Wireless Controller
shortDescription: PS5 controller with haptic feedback and adaptive triggers.
longDescription: DualSense delivers immersive haptics, responsive triggers, and a built-in mic. Compatible with PS5 and PC.

name: Mechanical Gaming Keyboard
shortDescription: RGB mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches.
longDescription: Compact mechanical keyboard with durable switches and customizable RGB lighting. Includes USB-C cable.
